heard: The sun is the most perfect sphere in nature. Even violent 11-year magnetic storms cannot bulge its disk. NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory measured this roundness from space. Deep inside, fusion converts hydrogen into helium. The proton-proton chain generates 99% of that power. The CNO cycle adds around 1% more. This energy drives a magnetized solar wind. That wind inflates a giant shield called the heliosphere. Voyager 1 crossed it into interstellar space. Yet across all scales, the sun remains a perfect sphere.
